title: Two Vocabularies, One Phenomenon: Metadata Bias in AI Evidence Synthesis on Fertility Decline

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing OpenAlex publication records using clinical versus social science vocabularies for fertility decline to evaluate differences in metadata completeness (e.g., DOI, ORCID, Crossref), open access status, and formatting.

Analyzing the disparity in machine readability, volume, and format types (articles vs. books/dissertations) between clinical/medical literature and social science literature to show how synthesis tools under-read social framing.
